_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. See SETUP.md. Never share config.json: whoever has it controls your server.
pelicanUrl: FILL IN (panel mode): your panel address, e.g. https://panel.example.com
pelicanApiKey: FILL IN (panel mode): account API key from the panel, not the application key
serverId: FILL IN (panel mode): server id from the panel URL after /server/

local.galaxyPath: FILL IN (local mode): folder with the galaxy and its logs

ftp.host: FILL IN (ftp mode): your hoster's ftp address
ftp.dir: FILL IN (ftp mode): the folder that holds the galaxy and its logs

discordToken: FILL IN: bot token from the Discord developer portal
discordChannelId: FILL IN: id of the Discord chat channel

ai.apiKey: FILL IN if enabled: API key of your model provider
ai.persona: Dry, deadpan, faintly superior. Sarcastic but never cruel: mock the situation, never the person. Short sentences.

welcome.text: Welcome to the server, {user}. Type !commands for the list.
